dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: 49ers (8-1) Week 10 Postgame Briefing: 46-40 Win Over Dallas Cowboys
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: San Francisco (8-1) closed out Week 10 with a 46-40 victory over the Dallas Cowboys [49ers.com Official](https://www.49ers.com/news/christian-mccaffrey-keeps-the-records-falling-in-49ers-46-40-win-over-cowboys), strengthening NFC positioning entering Week 11 against the Minnesota Vikings. Postgame evaluations centered on Brock Purdy's pocket execution, Raheem Morris's defensive adjustments, and roster recovery while maintaining $39.18M in 2026 salary cap flexibility [49ers Webzone](https://www.49erswebzone.com/articles/205213-49ers-warner-doesnt-brock-league/).
bullets: Postgame Execution & Film Takeaways: Kyle Shanahan's offense balanced situational run efficiency and intermediate passing against the Dallas Cowboys [49ers Webzone](https://www.49erswebzone.com/articles/205211-49ers-cowboys-grades-worst-counts/), while Raheem Morris leaned on disciplined secondary coverage and interior disruption to close out critical second-half possessions [Matt Maiocco](https://bsky.app/profile/mattmaiocco.bsky.social/post/3n2gzerhbvs2o).

Postgame Health & Week 11 Recovery: Medical staff monitor WR Mike Evans (Achilles), DT C.J. West (knee), and CB Nate Hobbs (groin) coming out of Week 10 while DT C.J. West's 21-day IR practice window remains active ahead of early-week evaluations for the Minnesota Vikings [Tim Kawakami](https://bsky.app/profile/timkawakami.bsky.social/post/3n2h5hkzzx22m).

Cap Rollover & Week 11 Outlook: Paraag Marathe preserves $39.18M in 2026 gross cap space for 1-for-1 CBA Article 13 rollover against 2027's -$36.74M void years projection as San Francisco prepares for the Minnesota Vikings [Kerry Crowley](https://sfstandard.com/2026/11/16/brock-purdy-brian-flores-49ers-vikings/).

rawStream.title: 9 Winners, 7 losers, and 1 IDK from the 49ers win over the Cowboys
rawStream.summary: (Photo by Stacy Revere/Getty Images) | Getty Images The San Francisco 49ers and Dallas Cowboys came close to reaching 100 points in Week 10. It was a game where defense was optional. The offenses had their way. Big plays were the norm, and

playerSnippets.13729: The 49ers have been sloppy for three weeks now, and the penalties are starting to add up. They had 11 against Dallas, giving the Cowboys a full football field (100 yards) of penalties.
playerSnippets.16737: He had a 25% target share — which is Mike Evans territory.. Four of Allen’s receptions resulted in a first down, and he should’ve had five if Purdy didn’t miss him toward the end of the game.
playerSnippets.2971282: DeForest Buckner had three pressures. Sebastian Valdez had two, and James Thompson had one.
playerSnippets.3040151: Kittle had a 20+ yard screen pass. He had four first-down receptions on nine targets.
playerSnippets.3117251: McCaffrey topped 20 mph on his 66-yard touchdown. He did a fantastic job making himself available and getting into Purdy’s line of sight on the 74-yard touchdown..
playerSnippets.3126486: Deebo had a 70-yard touchdown on a play where Cowboys defenders didn’t figure out he had the ball until he was 20 yards downfield. Samuel had two other carries for four yards.
playerSnippets.3916903: Bosa had five pressures and would’ve forced a turnover had Dre Greenlaw caught the ball. That removes one score off the board..
playerSnippets.4035840: Osa Odighizuwa had three run stops and four pressures. That’s about as well as he can play.
playerSnippets.4040605: Among the edge rushers who played at least 50 snaps in Week 10, Nick Bosa ranked third in pass-rush win rate at 15.8%. Bosa had five pressures and would’ve forced a turnover had Dre Greenlaw caught the ball.
playerSnippets.4242488: Lenoir was targeted 17 times against Dallas. Over half of those came in the first half.
playerSnippets.4243493: Keion White beats his man cleanly. Dak Prescott gets hit at the top of his drop.
playerSnippets.4361741: Purdy led all quarterbacks in Week 10 with a 0.77 EPA per pass. Second-place Matthew Stafford was 0.63.
playerSnippets.4427325: Coming into the game, Renardo Green was up against CeeDee Lamb, and Lenoir was up against George Pickens. On the surface, it makes sense.
playerSnippets.4431466: Watkins kicked things off with a 22-yard reception. He had a 27-yarder where Purdy bought time, waiting for someone to get open, while Watkins picked himself up off the ground and made himself available.
playerSnippets.4431523: Of the 115 offensive linemen to play at least 50 snaps in Week 10, Colby ranked 112th with a 17.1% pressure rate allowed. Usually, Colby makes up for it in the run game.
playerSnippets.4685523: Prysock went in for Renardo Green after Green left with a back injury. Prysock played 28 snaps.
playerSnippets.4685623: Filtering it down to at least 25 pass-rush snaps, White was 19th in pass-rush win rate, and Mykel Williams was 21st.
playerSnippets.4696211: Malik Mustapha had a picture-perfect hit. The refs huddled up, talked it over, and still decided Mustapha made illegal contact.
playerSnippets.4775220: Sebastian Valdez had two, and James Thompson had one. Pass-rush win rate is a better indicator of how a player performed.

rawStream.title: The 49ers reinstated Aiyuk (personal) from the reserve/left squad list Monday and were granted a two-week roster exemption for the wide receiver.
rawStream.summary: In what amounted to a procedural transaction after Aiyuk met with team officials Friday upon filing his paperwork for reinstatement, the 49ers now have until Nov. 23 to add him to the 53-man roster, release him or trade him. Given that Aiyuk owes the 49ers roughly $13 million in bonus forfeiture, securing a release from the team could prove difficult, though it's possible that the two sides work out a repayment plan that would allow him to become a free agent. In addition to the financial complications potentially delaying Aiyuk's return to the field, it's unclear if the 49ers or any other team have interest in rostering the 28-year-old wideout, who hasn't played an NFL snap since tearing the ACL and MCL in his right knee Oct. 20, 2024 and undergoing surgery.
rawStream.author: Tom Pelissero
